evidence: From the car park next to the caretaker’s house, follow the marked track through the trees to the swing bridge over the Waiotauru River.
The track down from Alpha Hut to the Kaitoke carpark leads through the saddle of Hell’s Gate, over Omega, and through the stunted silver beech along the Marchant Ridge.
It joins to Dobsons Loop Track before exiting on Marchant Road.
Look carefully for the track turn-off into the Kiwi Ranch Road car park.

doubts: No road-end features: the Otaki Forks start is given as the Ōtaki Forks place (the text says 'the car park next to the caretaker’s house'), and the Kaitoke end (Kaitoke carpark / Kiwi Ranch Road car park / Marchant Road) has no matching entry, so null. 'Table Top' in the text is linked to the separate 'Field Hut and Table Top' walk (L1); on this way it is the alpine area, so T32 is used in via and L1 only listed as another walk. Omega is said to be passed 'over' in the intro but later only its track turn-off is passed; kept in via with the peak ref. Direction is the Ōtaki to Kaitoke direction described; the page does not describe the reverse.
